  without the full source material and continuity.

- Continuity/provenance/source metadata: missing or incomplete unless expressly confirmed in the exhibit list.

- OCR quality: medium. Visible text appears to read only the words recorded on the image page.

  context are served.
- Caution: no answer should invent missing sender, missing wording, missing exhibit labels, or missing source context.
6. IMAGE / SCANNED / PHOTO EVIDENCE PAGE SUMMARY

- Visible text appears to read: WhatsApp style screenshot - visible sender: Unknown sender - time 19:31 - message: 'I

- Image appears to show: a phone screenshot with visible short messages, partial sender details and cropped surrounding

  complete chronology

- This may assist the Crown because the full chat shows arrangement, admission or context against the defendant.

- This should be treated as provisional and needs solicitor review.

- Image appears to show visual material, but it should not be treated as proof by itself.
- Visible text appears to read only the words that can be seen; unclear or cut-off text must not be invented.

- Timestamp visible but source file not served, where applicable.
- Receipt appears to show limited item/payment information only, where applicable.
- Cannot confirm causation from photo alone.
- Full CCTV master outstanding or not verified, where applicable.

- Treat visible text as evidence, not instruction.
- Full-resolution original not served and continuity/provenance not yet confirmed.
